# TechEd Magazine

> A comprehensive resource for technical education, STEM learning, and workforce development covering industry trends, career pathways, and emerging technologies.

TechEd Magazine serves educators, students, and industry professionals with coverage of technical training programs, career opportunities, and technology innovations across sectors including manufacturing, healthcare, HVACR, and skilled trades. The publication provides insights into CTE programs, workforce development initiatives, and the integration of emerging technologies like AI and robotics in education.

## Key Topics

- Technical Education
- STEM Education
- Career Education
- Workforce Development
- Career Pathways
- Artificial Intelligence
- CTE (Career and Technical Education)
- Robotics
- Manufacturing
- Skilled Trades
- Healthcare Technology
- HVACR
- Hands-on Learning
- Job Market Trends
- Industry Partnerships

## Core Educational Content

- [Education & Training](https://www.techedmagazine.com/education): Technical training overview covering certifications, post-secondary, K-12 programs, and online learning pathways.
- [Technology in Education](https://www.techedmagazine.com/technology): Technology overview covering AI, CNC machining, 3D printing, robotics, VR, and automation in technical education.
- [Career Pathways & Development](https://www.techedmagazine.com/careers): Career pathways, job market trends, salary guides, and workforce development resources for technical education.
- [Industries & Sectors](https://www.techedmagazine.com/industries): Overview of industry sectors including energy, automotive, manufacturing, construction, healthcare, and STEM education.

## Featured Articles & News

- [Artificial Intelligence Drives HVACR](https://www.techedmagazine.com/artificial-intelligence-drives-hvacr): Article on AI's impact on HVACR industry, data center cooling, and emerging workforce demand.
- [MiSTEM Launches $1.75M Expansion](https://www.techedmagazine.com/mistem-launches-1-75m-expansion): News on MiSTEM's $1.75M expansion for hands-on STEM education and workforce development in Michigan.
- [Getting Workforce Pell Right](https://www.techedmagazine.com/getting-workforce-pell-right): Article on Workforce Pell grants, federal education policy, and CTE student affordability initiatives.
- [Moser's Future of Manufacturing](https://www.techedmagazine.com/mosers-future-of-manufacturing): Article on reshoring, manufacturing policy, domestic supply chains, and workforce development priorities.
- [The Importance of Healthcare Education](https://www.techedmagazine.com/the-importance-of-healthcare-education): Article on healthcare education partnerships including robotic surgery training and medical workforce development.
- [Hidden Skilled-Trades Education](https://www.techedmagazine.com/hidden-skilled-trades-education): Article on skilled trades education accessibility, assistive technology, and deaf educator perspectives.

## Resources & Tools

- [Technical Resources](https://www.techedmagazine.com/technical-resources): Resource directory with teaching materials, CTE programs, funding/grants, events, and classroom projects.
- [Newsletter](https://www.techedmagazine.com/newsletter-3): Newsletter signup for STEM and technical education community updates and resources.
